usage: deskops view task [-h] [--root ROOT] [--format {text,json}] task_id

Task view: the board card plus the TaskDoc sections, next actions and the
advance revision.

positional arguments:
  task_id               Task selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename,
                        stem, or unique slug fragment where supported.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --format {text,json}  Output format.
